title: A BLANK key on the many side belongs to the blank row, together with keys that have no match

source.quote: or null values, meaning no value for date at all
source.supports: rows with a null key are added to the blank group, like rows with a non-matching key

source.quote: all the different values of Sales[ProductKey] with no corresponding row in Product are linked to the single blank row
source.supports: every unmatched key is linked to the one blank row

derivation: Bike (1): Sales row 1 = 100. Lock (2): row 2 = 30. Bell (3) has no sales: BLANK, row removed. Row 3 has a BLANK ProductKey and row 4 has ProductKey 9, which Product lacks: both belong to the single blank row: 50 + 20 = 70.
